problems.problem: Sign error: when the boat points straight across (θ=0°), the downstream drift is +s × t_min (downstream positive), not negative.
problems.verifierReason: Downstream drift positive when θ=0; original has wrong sign.

problems.quote: minimum drift is achieved by pointing straight upstream ( θ = 90° ), but the boat will still be carried downstream
problems.problem: At θ=90° the boat points straight upstream, so its across-river component is zero and it never crosses the river; the minimum drift for a successful crossing when s > b occurs at an angle θ where sin θ = b/s, not at 90°.
problems.correction: minimum drift for a crossing when s > b is achieved at sin θ = b/s (not θ = 90°)
problems.verifierReason: At θ=90° no crossing; min drift at sin θ=b/s for s>b.

problems.quote: the harmonic mean of times gives the correct combined time only when the work quantum is identical for each worker
problems.problem: The harmonic mean of times is not the combined time when workers work together; combined time is the reciprocal of the sum of rates (half the harmonic mean). The condition about identical work quantum does not make it correct.
problems.correction: the combined time is the reciprocal of the sum of rates, not the harmonic mean of times
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly states harmonic mean gives combined time; correction correctly gives reciprocal of sum of rates.
